# Stable Desktop-folder release packaging

This packaging workspace leaves the reviewed extension source and its previously
delivered versioned ZIP unchanged. End users need no script or installation.

## Latest requested workflow

Future deliveries should contain one stable folder named **NFSU2-Driving-Tools**,
without a version suffix. For first installation, extract the ZIP and drag that
real folder onto Desktop, then Load unpacked that folder once. The ZIP itself
does not run or install the extension. For later updates, preserve the exact
loaded folder and replace its contents from inside the newly extracted folder.
Click Reload on the existing extension card, then refresh the game. Do not move,
rename, nest or create a new extension folder per version. If Chrome already
loads a different folder, continue updating that existing path instead of
silently relocating it. No migration or live-PC change is performed here.

This future-format change does not replace or modify already delivered v0.31
or v0.32 ZIPs. No new user artifact is requested as part of this change.

## Build the next update

After reviewing/testing a complete extension release and aligning its manifest,
game badge, popup and diagnostic version metadata:

    python3 tools/package-folder-update.py \
      --layout desktop-folder \
      --source ../combined-v031-integration/extension \
      --output ../NFSU2-Driving-Tools-Next-Desktop-Folder.zip

Use a new output filename for each release. Existing outputs are immutable. The
ZIP's one top-level folder is always `NFSU2-Driving-Tools`, independent of the
archive's versioned name. The extension files are directly inside that folder.
Use the reviewed next-release source, not the sample v0.31 path shown above.
The user copies the folder to Desktop for first installation only. Thereafter
they copy its contents into the exact folder already loaded in Chrome, then
Reload the existing extension card and refresh the game.

The default `--layout flat` remains available solely to preserve historical
builds and their reproducibility. Future releases should explicitly select
`--layout desktop-folder`. The two layouts share the same unmodified runtime;
their archive paths, installation README, guide and checksum metadata differ.

The builder preserves every runtime byte and CHANGELOG. It replaces the README's
outdated Quick start/rollback instructions, adds UPDATE-WINDOWS.txt and adds a
SHA-256 inventory. Runtime changes belong in the reviewed source, not here.

This builder deliberately supports the currently reviewed, flat MV3 layout.
Missing/extra files, symlinks, subdirectories, duplicate/case-colliding or unsafe
Windows filenames, permission/host/config expansion and inconsistent version
labels are rejected. If the extension genuinely changes structure, review and
adapt the builder and tests rather than weakening checks ad hoc. The README
anchors are checked and must be updated deliberately if the document changes.
The tool never writes into its source extension directory or an existing output.
Checksums detect corruption, not authenticity.

## Validation

    python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

The suite currently has 31 passing tests. Negative cases cover missing or extra
files, symlinks, traversal/reserved names, duplicate/case names, broader hosts,
frames/permissions/background code, invalid versions, version mismatches,
unsupported docs and existing/source-contained output. Positive cases compare
every original runtime byte to the delivered v0.31 archive, verify checksums,
canonical metadata and repeated identical builds, and model copying/rollback
into an existing folder without touching unrelated files or browser/game data.
The overlay model is not a live Windows or browser test. New tests verify the
stable Desktop folder, first-install versus later-update instructions, exact
runtime/receipt bytes, future-version folder stability, reproducibility and
unchanged historical flat ZIP output.

NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.31-Same-Folder-Update.zip is 230,283 bytes, contains 26 flat

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASE = ROOT.parent / 'combined-v031-integration' / 'extension'
OLD_ZIP = ROOT.parent / 'NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.31-Combined-Drag-Retention.zip'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('folder_package', ROOT / 'tools/package-folder-update.py')
builder = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(builder)


class PackageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.home = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.source = self.home / 'extension'
        shutil.copytree(BASE, self.source)
        self.output = self.home / 'release.zip'

    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def manifest(self, change):
        path = self.source / 'manifest.json'
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        change(data)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))

    def reject(self):
        with self.assertRaises((ValueError, TypeError, FileNotFoundError)):
            builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        self.assertFalse(self.output.exists())

    def test_flat_complete_archive(self):
        result = builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(self.output) as z:
            self.assertIsNone(z.testzip())
            self.assertEqual(len(z.namelist()), 26)
            self.assertEqual(len(set(n.casefold() for n in z.namelist())), 26)
            self.assertTrue(all('/' not in n and '\\' not in n for n in z.namelist()))
            self.assertIn('manifest.json', z.namelist())
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(z.read('manifest.json'))['version'], '0.31.0')
        self.assertEqual(result['version'], '0.31.0')

    def test_every_runtime_byte_matches_delivered_v031(self):
        builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(self.output) as new, zipfile.ZipFile(OLD_ZIP) as old:
            for name in [p.name for p in BASE.iterdir() if p.name != 'README.md']:
                with self.subTest(name=name):
                    self.assertEqual(new.read(name), old.read('NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.31.0/' + name))
                    self.assertEqual(new.read(name), (BASE / name).read_bytes())

    def test_receipt_matches_all_payloads(self):
        builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(self.output) as z:
            receipt = json.loads(z.read(builder.CHECKSUMS))
            self.assertEqual(set(receipt['files']), set(z.namelist()) - {builder.CHECKSUMS})
            for name, details in receipt['files'].items():
                self.assertEqual(details['sha256'], hashlib.sha256(z.read(name)).hexdigest())
                self.assertEqual(details['bytes'], len(z.read(name)))

    def test_canonical_and_reproducible(self):
        builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        other = self.home / 'second.zip'
        builder.package(self.source, other)
        self.assertEqual(self.output.read_bytes(), other.read_bytes())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(self.output) as z:
            for entry in z.infolist():
                self.assertEqual(entry.date_time, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                self.assertEqual(entry.create_system, 3)
                self.assertEqual(entry.external_attr >> 16, 0o100644)

    def test_refuses_overwrite(self):
        self.output.write_bytes(b'original delivery')
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        self.assertEqual(self.output.read_bytes(), b'original delivery')

    def test_source_unchanged_and_output_cannot_live_in_source(self):
        before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in self.source.iterdir()}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            builder.package(self.source, self.source / 'release.zip')
        builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in self.source.iterdir()})

    def test_overlay_is_repeatable_and_preserves_unrelated_files(self):
        builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        loaded = self.home / 'old-version-name'
        loaded.mkdir()
        (loaded / 'manifest.json').write_text('old')
        (loaded / 'page.js').write_text('old')
        (loaded / 'user-notes.txt').write_text('keep')
        browser = self.home / 'browser-profile'
        browser.mkdir()
        (browser / 'nfsu2-site-storage.json').write_text('{"saved": "profile"}')
        game = self.home / 'game-backup.dat'
        game.write_bytes(b'game progress')
        with zipfile.ZipFile(self.output) as z:
            for _ in range(2):
                # Models copying every flat file into an existing folder, not Windows UI.
                for name in z.namelist():
                    (loaded / name).write_bytes(z.read(name))
                for name in z.namelist():
                    self.assertEqual((loaded / name).read_bytes(), z.read(name))
        self.assertEqual((loaded / 'user-notes.txt').read_text(), 'keep')
        self.assertEqual((browser / 'nfsu2-site-storage.json').read_text(), '{"saved": "profile"}')
        self.assertEqual(game.read_bytes(), b'game progress')
        self.assertFalse(any(p.is_dir() for p in loaded.iterdir()))

    def test_manual_rollback_restores_old_runtime(self):
        builder.package(self.source, self.output)
        loaded = self.home / 'same-folder'
        loaded.mkdir()

    def test_instructions_distinguish_both_reload_steps(self):
        _, files = builder.collect(self.source)

    def test_future_version_uses_same_flat_paths(self):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a reproducible ZIP to update an already loaded extension folder.

This tool is for release builders; end users only need File Explorer. It never
modifies the input extension, an installed browser, profiles, or prior archives.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import zipfile

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
GUIDE = 'UPDATE-WINDOWS.txt'
CHECKSUMS = 'PACKAGE-CHECKSUMS.json'
DESKTOP_FOLDER = 'NFSU2-Driving-Tools'
LAYOUTS = ('flat', 'desktop-folder')


def fail(message):
    raise ValueError(message)


def flat_name(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*', value):
        fail('Expected a plain, flat filename: ' + repr(value))
    stem = value.split('.')[0].upper()
    if value.endswith('.') or stem in {'CON', 'PRN', 'AUX', 'NUL', *(f'COM{i}' for i in range(1, 10)), *(f'LPT{i}' for i in range(1, 10))}:
        fail('Unsafe Windows filename: ' + value)
    return value


def render_readme(raw, version, layout='flat'):
    start = raw.find('### Quick start\n')
    end = raw.find('### Take control and pause\n', start)
    if start < 0 or end <= start:
        fail('Review README installation sections before packaging this release.')
    quick = f'''### Quick start

**Already installed:** keep your existing loaded folder. Copy all files from this
flat ZIP into it, replace matching files, click **Reload** on its existing card
in `chrome://extensions`, then refresh the game and verify **{version}**.
Do not remove/re-add the extension or create a new version folder.
See `UPDATE-WINDOWS.txt` for the full Windows steps and rollback instructions.

**First installation only:** create a permanent folder such as
`Documents\\NFSU2-Driving-Tools`, copy this ZIP's files into it so `manifest.json`
is directly inside, then use **Load unpacked** once and choose that folder.
Keep only one copy enabled. Edge uses `edge://extensions`; Brave uses
`brave://extensions`. Developer mode must be on to show the unpacked controls.

Finish your event and use the game's save/backup controls before a refresh;
unsaved in-memory changes are lost. Begin any new race yourself. Settings and
safety rules below are unchanged. Chrome 111+ or a compatible current desktop
Chromium browser is required. No build tools or Node installation are needed.

'''
    if layout == 'desktop-folder':
        quick = f'''### Quick start

**First installation:** extract the ZIP, then drag the extracted
`NFSU2-Driving-Tools` folder onto your Desktop. `manifest.json` must be directly
inside it. The ZIP itself does not run the extension. In `chrome://extensions`,
enable Developer mode, use **Load unpacked** once, and select that Desktop folder.

**Later updates:** keep that exact folder. Extract the next ZIP elsewhere, open
its `NFSU2-Driving-Tools` folder, and copy all files **inside** into your existing

If Chrome already loads a different folder, keep updating that path instead;
placing another copy on Desktop does not change the path Chrome loads. Keep only

Finish the event and use the game's save/backup controls before refreshing;
unsaved in-memory changes are lost. Settings and safety rules below are unchanged.
Chrome 111+ or a compatible current desktop Chromium browser is required.
No build tools, installer or Node installation are needed.

    text = raw[:start] + quick + raw[end:]
    text, count = re.subn(
        r'For rollback, disable v[^\n]+Never run both versions together\.',
        'For rollback, copy your complete previous extension files into the same loaded folder, '
        'Reload its existing extension card, then refresh the game. Keep the backup outside '

    return text.encode('utf-8')


def collect(source, layout='flat'):
    if layout not in LAYOUTS:
        fail('Unsupported archive layout.')
    source = source.absolute()
    if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_dir():
        fail('Source must be a real extension directory.')
    entries = list(source.iterdir())
    if any(p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() for p in entries):
        fail('Source must contain regular files only; no symlinks or subdirectories.')
    manifest = json.loads((source / 'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    version = manifest.get('version', '')
    if not isinstance(version, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'\d+(?:\.\d+){0,3}', version) or any(int(n) > 65535 or (len(n) > 1 and n.startswith('0')) for n in version.split('.')) or not any(int(n) for n in version.split('.')):
        fail('Invalid Chrome version.')
    if manifest.get('manifest_version') != 3 or not manifest.get('name', '').startswith('NFSU2 Driving Tools'):
        fail('Unexpected extension identity.')
    # New permissions/background code need a separate review, not silent packaging.
    allowed_keys = {'manifest_version', 'name', 'version', 'description', 'minimum_chrome_version', 'action', 'content_scripts'}
    if set(manifest) - allowed_keys:
        fail('Manifest has new capabilities; review before updating the package allowlist.')
    action = manifest.get('action', {})
    if set(action) != {'default_title', 'default_popup'} or action['default_popup'] != 'popup.html':
        fail('Unexpected popup configuration.')
    scripts = manifest.get('content_scripts', [])
    if len(scripts) != 1:
        fail('Expected one content-script entry.')
    block = scripts[0]
    if set(block) != {'matches', 'js', 'run_at', 'world', 'all_frames'} or block.get('matches') != ['https://nfsu2.xyz/*'] or block.get('world') != 'MAIN' or block.get('run_at') != 'document_start' or block.get('all_frames') is not False:
        fail('Unexpected host, frame or execution permissions.')
    if not isinstance(block.get('js'), list) or not block['js']:
        fail('No content scripts.')
    names = ['README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'manifest.json', 'popup.html', *block['js']]
    names = [flat_name(name) for name in names]
    if len(set(name.casefold() for name in names)) != len(names):
        fail('Duplicate or case-colliding file reference.')
    actual = {p.name for p in entries}
    if set(names) != actual:
        fail('Source inventory mismatch. Missing: ' + str(sorted(set(names) - actual)) + '; unexpected: ' + str(sorted(actual - set(names))))
    files = {name: (source / name).read_bytes() for name in names}
    markers = {
        'page.js': [f"version:'{version}'", f'class="version">{version}</'],
        'popup.html': [f'class="version">v{version}</'],
        'diagnostics.js': [f"version='{version}'"],
    }
    for name, expected in markers.items():
        if name not in files or any(marker.encode('utf-8') not in files[name] for marker in expected):
            fail('Version display/log metadata does not match manifest: ' + name)
    files['README.md'] = render_readme(files['README.md'].decode('utf-8'), version, layout)
    guide_template = GUIDE if layout == 'flat' else 'UPDATE-WINDOWS-DESKTOP.txt'
    files[GUIDE] = (HERE / 'templates' / guide_template).read_text(encoding='utf-8').format(version=version).replace('\n', '\r\n').encode('utf-8')
    receipt = {'format': 1, 'extension_version': version, 'layout': 'flat-copy-into-existing-loaded-folder', 'files': {name: {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()} for name, data in sorted(files.items())}}
    if layout == 'desktop-folder':
        receipt['layout'] = 'stable-desktop-folder'
        receipt['folder'] = DESKTOP_FOLDER
    files[CHECKSUMS] = (json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    return version, files


def package(source, output, layout='flat'):
    if output.resolve().is_relative_to(source.resolve()):
        fail('Output must be outside the source extension directory.')
    version, files = collect(source, layout)
    prefix = DESKTOP_FOLDER + '/' if layout == 'desktop-folder' else ''
    # Exclusive creation keeps already delivered files immutable.
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output, 'x', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as archive:
        for name, data in sorted(files.items()):
            entry = zipfile.ZipInfo(prefix + name, date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            entry.create_system = 3
            entry.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
            entry.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            archive.writestr(entry, data, compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(output) as archive:
        if archive.testzip() is not None or set(archive.namelist()) != {prefix + name for name in files}:
            fail('Archive verification failed.')
        for name, data in files.items():
            if archive.read(prefix + name) != data:
                fail('Archive content mismatch: ' + name)
    return {'path': str(output.absolute()), 'version': version, 'bytes': output.stat().st_size, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'files': sorted(prefix + name for name in files), 'runtime_unchanged': True}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--source', required=True, type=Path, help='Reviewed extension directory')
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path, help='New ZIP path; an existing file is never overwritten')
    parser.add_argument('--layout', choices=LAYOUTS, default='flat', help='Use desktop-folder for future releases; flat preserves historical packages')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(package(args.source, args.output, args.layout), indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

          const sizeAt=p.i,bodyLen=read(bytes,p),fnStart=p.i,fnEnd=fnStart+bodyLen;
          if(fnEnd>end)throw Error('Invalid game function');
          if(i===BRAKING.index-37){
            const fn=patchBrakingBody(bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===CORNER.index-37){
            const fn=patchCornerBody(bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd),a=locals(old),b=locals(BRIDGE);
            if(a.types.length!==31 || b.types.length!==64 || a.types.some((v,k)=>v!==b.types[k]) || old[old.length-1]!==11 || BRIDGE[BRIDGE.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Native AI hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(BRIDGE.subarray(0,BRIDGE.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));
            pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===PACE_TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd);
            if(locals(old).types.length!==1 || old[old.length-1]!==11 || PACE[PACE.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Native AI pace hook layout changed.');
            pieces.push(leb(PACE.length),PACE);changed++;
          }else if(i===WALL_TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd),a=locals(old),b=locals(WALL);
            if(a.types.length!==1 || a.types[0]!==127 || b.types.length!==19 || b.types[0]!==127 || old[old.length-1]!==11 || WALL[WALL.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Wall contact hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(WALL.subarray(0,WALL.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));
            pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else pieces.push(bytes.subarray(sizeAt,fnEnd));
          p.i=fnEnd;
        }
        if(changed!==5 || p.i!==end)throw Error('Native AI hooks were not found.');
        const section=join(...pieces);
        output=join(bytes.subarray(0,start),Uint8Array.of(10),leb(section.length),section,bytes.subarray(end));
        break;
      }
      p.i=end;
    }
    if(!output)throw Error('Native AI hook was not found.');
    return output;
  }
  function patchDragSelector(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),off=config.offset;
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==4 || a.types.some(t=>t!==127) || old[off]!==65 || old[off+1]!==3)
      throw Error('Native drag selector layout changed.');
    // The exact module hash pins the site; preserve every other native instruction.
    return join(Uint8Array.of(1,config.locals,127),old.subarray(a.end,off),Uint8Array.from(config.expression),old.subarray(off+2));
  }
  function patchDragInputBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]))
      throw Error('Native drag input lifecycle layout changed.');
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),Uint8Array.from(config.prefix),old.subarray(a.end));
  }
  function patchDragOverheatBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]))throw Error('Native drag overheat layout changed.');
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),Uint8Array.from(config.prefix),old.subarray(a.end));
  }
  function patchOwnedNosBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),off=config.offset,expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]) || old[off-3]!==65 || old[off-2]!==2 || old[off-1]!==71)
      throw Error('Native nitrous gate layout changed.');
    // Keep the original type2 comparison, then optionally accept the guarded owned player.
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),old.subarray(a.end,off),Uint8Array.from(config.expression),old.subarray(off));
  }
  function patchDriftRecoveryBody(old,config) {
    const a=locals(old),off=config.offset,expected=config.originalTypes.map(t=>({i32:127,f32:125,f64:124}[t]));
    if(old.length!==config.originalLength || a.types.length!==expected.length || a.types.some((t,i)=>t!==expected[i]) || config.needle.some((v,i)=>old[off+i]!==v) || config.slice.some((v,i)=>old[config.sliceOffset+i]!==v))
      throw Error('Native drift recovery layout changed.');
    // The full-module hash pins the body. Only its player-curve expression
    // and appended authored locals change; no calls, stores or persistent undo.
    return join(Uint8Array.from(config.header),old.subarray(a.end,off),Uint8Array.from(config.expression),old.subarray(off+config.needle.length));
  }
  function patchCurrent(bytes,profile) {
    const bridge=Uint8Array.from(profile.bridge),p={i:8};
    while(p.i<bytes.length){
      const start=p.i,id=bytes[p.i++],size=read(bytes,p),begin=p.i,end=begin+size;
      if(end>bytes.length)throw Error('Invalid current module section');
      if(id===10){
        const n=read(bytes,p),pieces=[bytes.subarray(begin,p.i)];let changed=0;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const at=p.i,len=read(bytes,p),body=p.i,stop=body+len;
          if(stop>end)throw Error('Invalid current function');
          const nos=profile.capabilities.ownedNativeNos && profile.ownedNos.find(c=>c.target===i);
          if(profile.capabilities.nativeDragOverheat && i===profile.dragOverheat.target){
            const fn=patchDragOverheatBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.dragOverheat);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.nativeDriftRecovery && i===profile.driftRecovery.target){
            const fn=patchDriftRecoveryBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.driftRecovery);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(nos){
            const fn=patchOwnedNosBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),nos);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff && i===profile.dragInputGuard.target){
            const fn=patchDragInputBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.dragInputGuard);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.opponentDrag && i===profile.dragSelector.target){
            const fn=patchDragSelector(bytes.subarray(body,stop),profile.dragSelector);pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===profile.target){
            const old=bytes.subarray(body,stop),a=locals(old),b=locals(bridge);
            if(a.types.length!==31||b.types.length!==profile.locals||a.types.some((v,k)=>v!==b.types[k])||old[old.length-1]!==11||bridge[bridge.length-1]!==11)throw Error('Current AI hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(bridge.subarray(0,bridge.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.pace && i===profile.pace.target){
            const old=bytes.subarray(body,stop),replacement=Uint8Array.from(profile.pace.bridge);
            if(locals(old).types.length!==1||old[old.length-1]!==11||replacement[replacement.length-1]!==11)throw Error('Current pace hook layout changed.');
            pieces.push(leb(replacement.length),replacement);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.corner && i===BRAKING.index-37){
            const fn=patchBrakingBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.corner && i===CORNER.index-37){
            const fn=patchCornerBody(bytes.subarray(body,stop));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(profile.capabilities.walls && i===profile.wall.target){
            const old=bytes.subarray(body,stop),replacement=Uint8Array.from(profile.wall.bridge),a=locals(old),b=locals(replacement);
            if(a.types.length!==1||a.types[0]!==127||b.types.length!==19||b.types[0]!==127||old[old.length-1]!==11||replacement[replacement.length-1]!==11)throw Error('Current wall hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(replacement.subarray(0,replacement.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else pieces.push(bytes.subarray(at,stop));
          p.i=stop;
        }
        if(changed!==1+Number(!!profile.capabilities.nativeDragOverheat)+Number(!!profile.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff)+Number(!!profile.capabilities.nativeDriftRecovery)+(profile.capabilities.ownedNativeNos?profile.ownedNos.length:0)+Number(!!profile.capabilities.opponentDrag)+Number(profile.capabilities.pace)+2*Number(profile.capabilities.corner)+Number(profile.capabilities.walls)||p.i!==end)throw Error('Current AI hook was not found.');
        const section=join(...pieces);return join(bytes.subarray(0,start),Uint8Array.of(10),leb(section.length),section,bytes.subarray(end));
      }
      p.i=end;
    }
    throw Error('Current code section was not found.');
  }
  // Called only after patchBytes verified the untouched source module. Extend
  // section vectors in place: no original indexes, data, tables or exports move.
  function patchHostedBytes(bytes,profile) {
    if(!HOSTED || profile?.hash!==HOSTED.hash) return null;
    const h=HOSTED,p={i:8},sections=[];let found=0;
    const append=(payload,count,suffix)=>{const q={i:0},n=read(payload,q);return join(leb(n+count),payload.subarray(q.i),suffix);};
    while(p.i<bytes.length){const id=bytes[p.i++],size=read(bytes,p),begin=p.i,end=begin+size;if(end>bytes.length)throw Error('Hosted module section changed.');let payload=bytes.subarray(begin,end);
      if(id===1){const q={i:0};if(read(payload,q)!==h.originalTypes)throw Error('Hosted type prefix changed.');payload=append(payload,h.typeCount,Uint8Array.from(h.types));found++;}
      if(id===3){const q={i:0};if(read(payload,q)!==h.originalFunctions-37)throw Error('Hosted function prefix changed.');payload=append(payload,h.functionTypes.length,join(...h.functionTypes.map(leb)));found++;}
      if(id===6){const q={i:0};if(read(payload,q)!==h.originalGlobals)throw Error('Hosted global prefix changed.');payload=append(payload,h.globalCount,Uint8Array.from(h.globals));found++;}
      if(id===10){const q={i:0},n=read(payload,q),pieces=[leb(n+h.bodies.length)];if(n!==h.originalFunctions-37)throw Error('Hosted code prefix changed.');let patchedCaller=false;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sizeAt=q.i,len=read(payload,q),at=q.i,stop=at+len;if(stop>payload.length)throw Error('Hosted body overflow.');
          if(i+37===h.caller){const old=payload.subarray(at,stop),o=h.offset;
            if(old.length!==h.callerLength || h.needle.some((v,k)=>old[o+k]!==v) || h.before.some((v,k)=>old[o-h.before.length+k]!==v) || h.after.some((v,k)=>old[o+h.needle.length+k]!==v))throw Error('Hosted frame anchor changed.');
            const body=join(old.subarray(0,o),Uint8Array.of(16),leb(h.frameIndex),old.subarray(o+h.needle.length));pieces.push(leb(body.length),body);patchedCaller=true;
          }else pieces.push(payload.subarray(sizeAt,stop));q.i=stop;
        }
        if(!patchedCaller||q.i!==payload.length)throw Error('Hosted frame hook missing.');
        for(const body of h.bodies){const b=Uint8Array.from(body);pieces.push(leb(b.length),b);}payload=join(...pieces);found++;
      }
      sections.push(Uint8Array.of(id),leb(payload.length),payload);p.i=end;
    }
    if(found!==4)throw Error('Hosted required sections missing.');return join(bytes.subarray(0,8),...sections);
  }
  function install() {
    if(installed || typeof WebAssembly.compileStreaming!=='function')return;
    installed=true;
    const nativeStreaming=WebAssembly.compileStreaming, nativeCompile=WebAssembly.compile;
    WebAssembly.compileStreaming=async function(source,options){
      const response=await source;
      let url;try{url=new URL(response.url);}catch{return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);}
      if(url.origin!==location.origin || url.pathname!=='/game.wasm')return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);
      const generation=++loadGeneration,state={phase:'preparing',reason:'Preparing native AI bridge.'};
      // Concurrent loads keep independent facts; only the newest observed load publishes diagnostics.
      const publish=()=>{if(generation!==loadGeneration)return;for(const key of Object.keys(patchState))delete patchState[key];Object.assign(patchState,state);};
      publish();
      let stage='module-read';
      try{
        const bytes=await response.clone().arrayBuffer();
        state.moduleBytes=bytes.byteLength;
        const candidate=profileForSize(bytes.byteLength);
        if(candidate)state.candidateRevision=candidate.revision;
        // Read-only fingerprint coverage. It never grants compatibility or changes hooks.
        const scanner=root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURES__,references=[root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURE_PROFILE__,root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURE_PROFILE_LATEST__,root.__NFSU2_SIGNATURE_PROFILE_NEXT__].filter(Boolean);
        if(scanner?.scanAll&&references.length)try{
          const result=await scanner.scanAll(bytes,references),summary=result.bestReference;
          state.moduleHash=summary.moduleSha256;
          Object.assign(state,{signatureReference:summary.referenceRevision,signatureExact:summary.referenceModuleMatches,signatureTotal:summary.anchors,signatureUnique:summary.unique,signatureAmbiguous:summary.ambiguous,signatureMissing:summary.missing});
        }catch{state.signatureFailed=true;}
        stage='module-layout';
        const changed=await patchBytes(bytes);
        stage='module-compile';
        const profile=profileForSize(bytes.byteLength);
        let module,hosted=null;
        // A hosted-only failure cannot remove verified v0.32 AI/tuner patches.
        try {
          const combined=patchHostedBytes(changed,profile);
          if(combined){module=await nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,combined,options);hosted=HOSTED;}
        } catch(e) {state.hostedReason=String(e?.message||'Hosted bridge unavailable.');}
        if(!module)module=await nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,changed,options);
        state.hostedAvailable=!!hosted;
        patched.set(module,profile);if(hosted)hostedProfiles.set(module,hosted);
        if(profile.capabilities.fullTuner&&root.__NFSU2_DYNO_NATIVE__){const prepared=root.__NFSU2_DYNO_NATIVE__.build(bytes);prepared.catch(()=>{});nativeEvaluators.set(module,prepared);}
        state.phase='ready';state.revision=profile.revision;state.reason='Verified game module · native AI bridge loaded.';
        publish();return module;
      }catch(e){
        state.phase='unavailable';state.reason=String(e?.message || 'Native AI could not be prepared.');
        state.patchCode=['module-size','module-hash'].includes(e?.patchCode)?e.patchCode:stage;
        if(typeof e?.moduleHash==='string'&&/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(e.moduleHash))state.moduleHash=e.moduleHash;
        // Fail open to the unchanged game, closed to AI control. All memory-writing tools still require a verified module profile.
        publish();return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);
      }
    };
  }
  class Controller {
    constructor(memory,available=false,capabilities=LEGACY.capabilities){this.memory=memory;this.available=!!available;this.capabilities=capabilities;this.hb=0;this.words=null;this.view=null;this.requestTarget=null;this.handbackPending=false;this.handbackHeartbeat=0;}
    refresh(){const b=this.memory.buffer;if(!this.view || this.view.buffer!==b){this.view=new DataView(b);this.words=new Int32Array(b);}return b.byteLength>=(this.capabilities.corner?CORNER.commandBase+64:BASE+92);}
    u32(p){return p>=0x10000 && p+4<=Math.min(this.view.byteLength,0x28000000)?this.view.getUint32(p,true):0;}
    read(off){return Atomics.load(this.words,(BASE+off)/4)>>>0;}
    write(off,v){Atomics.store(this.words,(BASE+off)/4,v|0);}
    cornerSettings(mode,pace,cornerAssist,cornerFactor,cornerMargin,raceCornerAssist,raceCornerFactor,raceCornerMargin,raceBraking,allowNetwork=false,adaptiveCorners=false){
      const raceType=this.u32(0x89e7b0),drag=!!this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d8);
      const special=drag||this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d9)||this.u32(0x890104)||this.u32(0x890108)||this.u32(0x890114);
      const network=(this.u32(0x850078)&520)||this.u32(0x866a14)||this.u32(0x8669f4)||this.view.getUint8(0x89cf69);
      const streetX=this.view.getUint8(0x89e7e3)||this.u32(0x89010c)||network&&this.u32(0x850088)===10;
      const command=!this.capabilities.corner?0:raceCornerAssist===true&&mode===1&&raceType===1&&!special&&(!network||allowNetwork===true)?adaptiveCorners===true&&this.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff===true&&!streetX&&Number.isFinite(pace)&&pace>=1&&pace<=2?3:2:cornerAssist===true&&mode===2&&raceType===0&&!drag?1:0;
      const factor=command>=2?raceCornerFactor:cornerFactor,sharp=command>=2?raceCornerMargin:cornerMargin;
      const percent=Number.isFinite(factor)&&factor>=.6&&factor<=.95?Math.round(factor*100):80;
      const margin=Number.isFinite(sharp)&&sharp>=0&&sharp<=25?Math.round(sharp):command>=2?15:0;
      const braking=command>=2?(Number.isFinite(raceBraking)&&raceBraking>=.5&&raceBraking<=1?Math.round(raceBraking*100):75):100;
      const pacePercent=command>=2&&this.capabilities.pace&&Number.isFinite(pace)&&pace>=.75&&pace<=3?Math.round(pace*100):100;
      return {command,percent,margin,braking,pacePercent};
    }
    nativeDriftPace() {
      return this.capabilities.nativeDriftPace===true && !this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d8) && !this.u32(0x890108) && !!(this.view.getUint8(0x89e7d9)||this.u32(0x890104)||this.u32(0x890114));
    }
    publish(wanted=0,player=0,car=0,race=0,pace=1,allowNetwork=false,allowDragAI=false,cornerAssist=false,cornerFactor=0.8,cornerMargin=0,raceCornerAssist=false,raceCornerFactor=.8,raceCornerMargin=15,raceBraking=.75,dragNoBlowout=false,adaptiveCorners=false){
      if(!this.available || !this.refresh() || this.read(28)!==MAGIC)return false;
      pace=this.capabilities.pace&&!this.nativeDriftPace()?pace:1;allowDragAI=this.capabilities.dragAI&&allowDragAI;cornerAssist=this.capabilities.corner&&cornerAssist;
      // OFF is a command the native loop must process, not merely a page
      // state. A quick same-event restart must not overwrite an unseen OFF.
      if(wanted===0 && this.read(8)!==0)this.handbackPending=true;
      let seq=this.read(4);if(seq&1)seq++;
      this.write(4,seq+1);this.write(0,MAGIC);this.write(8,wanted);this.write(12,player);this.write(16,car);this.write(20,race);
      this.write(60,Number.isFinite(pace) && pace>=0.75 && pace<=3 ? Math.round(pace*100) : 100);
      if(this.capabilities.nativeDragOverheat)this.write(100,dragNoBlowout===true?1:0);
      this.write(84,allowNetwork === true ? 1 : 0);this.write(88,allowDragAI === true ? 1 : 0);
      if(this.capabilities.corner){
      const {command,percent,margin,braking,pacePercent}=this.cornerSettings(wanted,pace,cornerAssist,cornerFactor,cornerMargin,raceCornerAssist,raceCornerFactor,raceCornerMargin,raceBraking,allowNetwork,adaptiveCorners);
      const cr=off=>Atomics.load(this.words,(CORNER.commandBase+off)/4)>>>0,cw=(off,v)=>Atomics.store(this.words,(CORNER.commandBase+off)/4,v|0);
      const cornerOwned=cr(0)===CORNER.commandMagic,cornerEmpty=Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>cr(i*4)).every(v=>v===0);
      if(cornerOwned||cornerEmpty){
      if(cr(0)!==CORNER.commandMagic || cr(4)!==command || cr(8)!==percent || cr(36)!==margin || cr(44)!==braking || cr(48)!==pacePercent || (cr(12)&&cr(12)!==car)){
        for(let off=12;off<36;off+=4)cw(off,0);cw(40,0);cw(52,0);cw(56,0);cw(60,0);
      }
      cw(0,CORNER.commandMagic);cw(4,command);cw(8,percent);cw(36,margin);cw(44,braking);cw(48,pacePercent);}}
      this.write(24,++this.hb);this.write(4,seq+2);
      if(wanted===0 && this.handbackPending)this.handbackHeartbeat=this.hb;
      return true;
    }
    handbackObserved(){
      const current=this.status();
      // Heartbeat observation precedes processing: latch and ownership must
      // also be cleared, and the current driver must be safely manual.
      return current.ready && !current.owned && current.manual && this.read(72)===0 && this.read(44)===(this.handbackHeartbeat>>>0);
    }
    stop(){this.publish(0);return this.status();}
    releaseForSwap(){
      this.publish(0);this.handbackHeartbeat=this.hb;
      const current=this.status();
      return current.available ? {...current,switching:true,status:'switching',reason:'Changing native event behavior or corner settings · waiting for native handback.'} : current;
    }
    update({enabled=false,safe=false,state=null,mode=0,pace=1,allowNetwork=false,allowDragAI=false,cornerAssist=false,cornerFactor=0.8,cornerMargin=0,raceCornerAssist=false,raceCornerFactor=.8,raceCornerMargin=15,raceBraking=.75,dragNoBlowout=false,adaptiveCorners=false}={}){
      this.refresh();
      allowDragAI=this.capabilities.dragAI&&allowDragAI;cornerAssist=this.capabilities.corner&&cornerAssist;pace=this.capabilities.pace?pace:1;
      raceCornerAssist=this.capabilities.corner&&raceCornerAssist===true&&(!state?.network||allowNetwork===true)&&!state?.drag;
      const player=this.u32(0xd00000);
      const wanted=!!enabled && !!safe && state?.ready && state.driving && (!state.network || allowNetwork === true) && (!state.drag || allowDragAI === true) && (mode===1 || mode===2) && this.u32(player+4)===state.car;
      // A completed OFF should stop displaying as pending even while the
      // user leaves AI disabled. Do not create another handshake for idle OFF.
      if(!wanted && this.handbackPending && this.handbackObserved())this.handbackPending=false;
      // A race can change type while reusing player/car/race pointers. Never
      // retain the previous mode's physics: release our native driver first.
      // Keep the remembered target across pause/stop, so a quick re-enable or
      // transition cannot hide an unprocessed native handback request.
      if(wanted){
        const raceType=this.u32(0x89e7b0);
        const corner=this.cornerSettings(mode,pace,cornerAssist,cornerFactor,cornerMargin,raceCornerAssist,raceCornerFactor,raceCornerMargin,raceBraking,allowNetwork,adaptiveCorners);
        // Native planned caps are cached: rebuild the private route on every
        // effective corner-profile/category change, never merely reissue ON.
        // These native race parameter / forced-mode flags select or specialize
        // the game's driver. Track identity also catches a new event reusing
        // every object pointer. We request reconstruction; never fake an
        // opponent racer type or substitute an extension steering algorithm.
        const event=[this.u32(0x89e7a0),this.u32(0x89e7b4),
          ...[0x89e7d8,0x89e7d9,0x89e7e1,0x89e7e3].map(a=>this.view.getUint8(a)),
          this.u32(0x890104),this.u32(0x890108),this.u32(0x89010c),this.u32(0x890114)];
        const target=[player,state.car,state.race,state.drag?'drag':'native',mode,raceType,...event,corner.command,corner.command?corner.percent:0,corner.command?corner.margin:0,corner.command>=2?corner.braking:0,corner.command>=2?corner.pacePercent:0].join(':');
        const changed=this.requestTarget!==null && this.requestTarget!==target;
        if(changed)this.handbackPending=true;
        this.requestTarget=target;
        if(changed)return this.releaseForSwap();
        if(this.handbackPending){
          if(!this.handbackObserved())return this.releaseForSwap();
          this.handbackPending=false;

  const canonical=n=>n===0?0:n;
  const signed=n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=-2147483648&&n<=2147483647;
  const finite=n=>Number.isFinite(n)&&Math.abs(n)<=3.4028234663852886e38;
  const nativeText=(value,max=64)=>typeof value==='string'&&value.length<=max?value.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]/g,'').trim():'';
  const reasons=Object.freeze(['Native career-open','Already won · multiplayer replay','Not open in career yet','Sign with a sponsor first','Sponsor contract has no place for this event','Opens after more wins','Needs an SUV']);
  function catalogDescriptor(row,catalogStage) {
    const d=descriptor(row);
    if(!d||![0,1,2,4,5].includes(row.rawType)||!Number.isInteger(catalogStage)||catalogStage<1||catalogStage>8||row.stage<1||row.stage>catalogStage||
      ![1,2,3].includes(row.category)||typeof row.suvRequired!=='boolean'||![1,2,3].includes(row.heatCount)||
      ![1,2].includes(row.kind)||!uint(row.why)||row.why>6||(row.kind===1?row.why!==0:row.why===0)||
      !uint(row.raceIndex)||row.raceIndex>1023||!uint(row.triggerId)||row.triggerId<65536||row.triggerId>=0x28000000||!nonzero(row.markerHash)||
      !Number.isInteger(row.triggerSize)||row.triggerSize<68||row.triggerSize>32767||row.triggerId+row.triggerSize>0x28000000||
      !row.route||!['x','y','z'].every(k=>signed(row.route[k]))||!row.marker||!['x','y','z'].every(k=>finite(row.marker[k]))||
      !row.heading||!['x','y'].every(k=>finite(row.heading[k]))||!Array.isArray(row.box)||row.box.length!==4||!row.box.every(finite)||row.box[0]>row.box[2]||row.box[1]>row.box[3]||
      !Array.isArray(row.heats)||row.heats.length!==row.heatCount)return null;
    const heats=[];
    for(const h of row.heats){
      if(!h||!Number.isInteger(h.track)||h.track<1||h.track>32767||h.track===4000||![0,1].includes(h.reverse)||!uint(h.laps)||h.laps>255)return null;
      heats.push(Object.freeze({track:h.track,reverse:h.reverse,laps:h.laps}));
    }
    if(heats[0].track!==row.track||heats[0].reverse!==row.reverse||heats[0].laps!==row.laps)return null;
    const route=Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(['x','y','z'].map(k=>[k,canonical(row.route[k])]))),marker=Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(['x','y','z'].map(k=>[k,canonical(row.marker[k])]))),heading=Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(['x','y'].map(k=>[k,canonical(row.heading[k])]))),box=Object.freeze(row.box.map(canonical));
    // Event and destination are separate: a stage/car variant at the same
    // native trigger is a different selection. Display text is never identity.
    const eventKey=JSON.stringify([d.key,row.category,row.suvRequired,heats.map(h=>[h.track,h.reverse,h.laps])]);
    const destinationKey=JSON.stringify([row.triggerId,row.markerHash,route.x,route.y,route.z,marker.x,marker.y,marker.z,box,heading.x,heading.y,row.triggerSize]);
    const key=JSON.stringify([eventKey,destinationKey]),kind=row.category===2?'URL':({0:'Circuit',1:'Sprint',2:'Street X',4:'Drag',5:'Drift'})[row.rawType];
    const nativeName=nativeText(row.nativeName,48),trackLabel=nativeText(row.trackLabel);
    const label=row.category===2&&row.heatCount>1?`URL · ${row.heatCount} heats · Stage ${row.stage}`:`${kind} · Stage ${row.stage} · ${trackLabel||'Track '+row.track}${row.reverse?' · reverse':''}${row.laps>1?' · '+row.laps+' laps':''}`;
    return Object.freeze({...d,key,eventKey,offerKey:d.key,destinationKey,source:'catalog',label,nativeName,trackLabel,triggerId:row.triggerId,markerHash:row.markerHash,category:row.category,suvRequired:row.suvRequired,heatCount:row.heatCount,heats:Object.freeze(heats),kind:row.kind,why:row.why,reason:reasons[row.why],restrictionKey:row.kind+':'+row.why,route,marker,heading,box,triggerSize:row.triggerSize});
  }
  const tuple=row=>nonzero(row?.host)&&nonzero(row?.lobby)&&descriptor(row)?JSON.stringify([row.host,row.lobby,descriptor(row).key]):null;
  const nativeLabels=['Idle nearby','Hosting manually','Join requested, not accepted','In lobby · waiting for host','Host countdown','Game trip / race / return'];
  class Queue {
    constructor({clock=()=>performance.now(),setRaceOnlyAI=()=>{},onChange=()=>{},onStop=()=>{}}={}) {
      this.clock=clock;this.setRaceOnlyAI=setRaceOnlyAI;this.onChange=onChange;this.onStop=onStop;this.client=null;this.rows=new Map();this.selected=new Set();this.selectionRestrictions=new Map();this.selectionContexts=new Map();this.catalogContext=null;this.catalogMode=false;this.catalogCurrent=new Map();this.catalogValid=false;this.catalogStatus='';this.active=false;this.pending=null;this.observationBusy=false;this.sample=null;this.sampleAt=null;this.nativeTime=null;this.lastClock=null;this.epoch=null;this.armSeq=0;this.armedAt=0;this.nextAttempt=0;this.attempts=new Map();this.visited=false;this.lastEvent=null;this.driverMissingAt=null;this.driverFailureAt=null;this.status='Off · choose events, then Start';this.reason='';this.context={};
    }
    bind(client) {
      this.stop('Game session changed. Press Start again.');
      if(this.client&&this.client!==client){try{this.client.detach();}catch{}}
      this.client=client;this.rows.clear();this.selected.clear();this.selectionRestrictions.clear();this.selectionContexts.clear();this.catalogContext=null;this.catalogMode=false;this.catalogCurrent.clear();this.catalogValid=false;this.catalogStatus='';this.observationBusy=false;this.sample=null;this.sampleAt=null;this.nativeTime=null;this.lastClock=null;this.epoch=null;this.status=client?'Off · waiting for verified native observations':'Unavailable · exact native bridge required';this.changed();
    }
    changed(){this.onChange();}
    observe(now) {
      this.observationBusy=false;
      let s=null,readFailed=false;try{s=this.client?.snapshot()||null;}catch{readFailed=true;}
      // A large shared snapshot may be briefly owned by the native publisher.
      // Retain only the last coherent observation for bounded UI/session grace;
      // no heartbeat, join, start or race ownership is granted from that cache.
      if(!s&&!readFailed){
        let busy=false;try{busy=this.client?.snapshotStatus==='busy';}catch{}
        if(busy&&this.fresh(now)&&now-this.sampleAt<=SNAPSHOT_BUSY_MS){this.observationBusy=true;return false;}
      }
      if(!s||!Number.isInteger(s.state)||s.state<0||s.state>5||typeof s.nativeNowBigInt!=='bigint'||!uint(s.epoch)||!uint(s.sequence)||!Array.isArray(s.offers)||s.offers.length>16){this.sample=null;return false;}
      if(this.nativeTime!==null&&s.nativeNowBigInt<this.nativeTime){this.sample=null;this.stop('Native clock changed. Press Start again.');return false;}
      if(this.nativeTime!==s.nativeNowBigInt){this.nativeTime=s.nativeNowBigInt;this.sampleAt=now;}
      this.sample=s;
      if(!this.fresh(now))return false;
      // v2 catalog presence is sticky for this client. Losing the catalog can
      // never turn an exact destination choice into a nearby event wildcard.
      if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s,'catalog')||Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s,'catalogValid'))this.catalogMode=true;
      if(this.catalogMode){
        let valid=s.catalogValid===true&&s.inRoam===true&&s.worldRuns===true&&s.uiEligible===true&&Number.isInteger(s.catalogStage)&&s.catalogStage>=1&&s.catalogStage<=8&&Array.isArray(s.catalog)&&s.catalog.length<=MAX_CATALOG;
        const contextFields=['carId','raceTableId','triggerFirst','triggerEnd'],metadata=s.catalogSnapshot;
        const hasContext=!!metadata&&contextFields.every(k=>nonzero(metadata[k])&&metadata[k]>=65536&&metadata[k]<0x28000000)&&metadata.triggerFirst<metadata.triggerEnd;
        if(!hasContext)valid=false;
        // A normal completed refresh is not a different selection context.
        // Car/source/stage replacement is, even if its visible row is identical.
        this.catalogContext=valid?JSON.stringify([s.catalogStage,...contextFields.map(k=>metadata[k])]):null;
        const current=new Map(),triggers=new Set(),events=new Map();
        if(valid)for(const raw of s.catalog){
          const d=catalogDescriptor(raw,s.catalogStage);
          // Duplicate trigger records or conflicting identities for one native
          // event hash invalidate the publication, rather than choosing first.
          if(!d||triggers.has(d.triggerId)||(events.has(d.eventHash)&&events.get(d.eventHash)!==d.eventKey)){valid=false;break;}
          triggers.add(d.triggerId);events.set(d.eventHash,d.eventKey);current.set(d.key,d);
        }
        if(!valid)current.clear();
        this.catalogCurrent=current;this.catalogValid=valid;
        this.catalogStatus=valid?`${current.size} current native city destination(s)${s.catalogRefreshing===true?' · native refresh in progress':''}`:'Current city catalog unavailable · previous choices are not eligible';
        const next=new Map(current);
        for(const key of this.selected)if(!next.has(key)&&this.rows.has(key))next.set(key,this.rows.get(key));
        this.rows=next;
      }else{
        // Legacy v1 retains the reviewed nearby-only behavior. It cannot match
        // or replace any v2 destination selection.
        for(const offer of [s.spot,...s.offers]){
          const d=descriptor(offer);if(!d)continue;
          if(!this.rows.has(d.key)&&this.rows.size>=MAX_NEARBY){const victim=[...this.rows.keys()].find(k=>!this.selected.has(k));if(victim)this.rows.delete(victim);}
          if(this.rows.has(d.key)||this.rows.size<MAX_NEARBY)this.rows.set(d.key,{...d,offerKey:d.key,source:'nearby',lastSeen:now});
        }
      }
      return true;
    }
    selectionCurrent(key) {
      const r=this.catalogCurrent.get(key);
      return !!r&&this.selectionRestrictions.get(key)===r.restrictionKey&&this.selectionContexts.get(key)===this.catalogContext;
    }
    selectedOffer(offer) {
      const d=descriptor(offer),s=this.sample;if(this.observationBusy||!d||!s)return null;
      if(!this.catalogMode)return this.selected.has(d.key)?this.rows.get(d.key):null;
      if(!this.catalogValid||descriptor(s.spot)?.key!==d.key)return null;
      for(const key of this.selected){
        const r=this.catalogCurrent.get(key);
        if(this.selectionCurrent(key)&&r.offerKey===d.key&&s.spot.triggerId===r.triggerId&&s.spot.markerHash===r.markerHash&&s.spot.kind===r.kind)return r;
      }
      return null;
    }
    fresh(now=this.clock()){return !!this.sample&&this.sampleAt!==null&&Number.isFinite(now)&&now>=this.sampleAt&&now-this.sampleAt<=FRESH_MS;}
    choose(key,yes) {
      if(this.active||this.observationBusy)return false;
      if(!this.rows.has(key))return false;
      if(yes){if(this.selected.size>=MAX_SELECTED&&!this.selected.has(key))return false;if(this.catalogMode&&(!this.fresh()||!this.catalogCurrent.has(key)))return false;this.selected.add(key);if(this.catalogMode){this.selectionRestrictions.set(key,this.catalogCurrent.get(key).restrictionKey);this.selectionContexts.set(key,this.catalogContext);}}else {this.selected.delete(key);this.selectionRestrictions.delete(key);this.selectionContexts.delete(key);}
      this.changed();return true;
    }
    clear(){this.stop('Choices cleared');this.rows=this.catalogMode?new Map(this.catalogCurrent):new Map();this.selected.clear();this.selectionRestrictions.clear();this.selectionContexts.clear();this.changed();}
    start(context) {
      if(this.active)return false;
      this.context=context||{};const now=this.clock(),observed=this.observe(now);
      const error=!this.context.allowNetwork?'Enable Allow network tools first. Start never enables it.':!this.context.supported?'A verified game and AI build are required.':this.context.hidden||this.context.focused===false?'Focus the visible game, then Start.':this.context.manualInput?'Release driving controls, then Start.':this.context.busy?'Finish the tuner action first.':!this.selected.size?'Select at least one native event.':!observed||!this.fresh(now)?'Waiting for a fresh verified native snapshot.':this.catalogMode&&[...this.selected].some(key=>!this.selectionCurrent(key))?'A selected destination is unavailable or changed. Review and reselect before Start.':this.sample.state!==0||this.sample.inRoam!==true||this.sample.uiEligible!==true?'Start from eligible free roam outside a lobby or race.':'';
      if(error){this.status=error;this.changed();return false;}
      let armed=false;try{armed=this.client.arm();}catch{}
      if(!armed){this.status='Native session could not arm. Nothing was joined.';this.changed();return false;}
      let armSeq=0;try{armSeq=this.client.snapshot()?.requestSeq;}catch{}
      if(!nonzero(armSeq)){try{this.client.stop();}catch{}this.status='Native arm identity was not confirmed. Press Start again.';this.changed();return false;}
      this.armSeq=armSeq;
      this.driverMissingAt=null;this.driverFailureAt=null;this.active=true;this.pending=null;this.attempts.clear();this.epoch=null;this.armedAt=now;this.nextAttempt=now;this.visited=false;this.lastEvent=null;this.status='Arming · waiting for native acknowledgement';this.reason='';
      this.setRaceOnlyAI(true);this.changed();return true;
    }
    stop(reason='Stopped') {
      const wasActive=this.active;this.active=false;this.pending=null;this.epoch=null;this.attempts.clear();this.visited=false;this.nextAttempt=0;
      try{this.client?.stop();}catch{}
      // Preserve the pre-existing standalone race-only mode when this queue is off.
      if(wasActive)this.setRaceOnlyAI(false);
      this.status=reason;this.reason=reason;this.changed();if(wasActive)this.onStop(reason);return wasActive;
    }
    failPending(now,reason) {
      this.pending=null;this.nextAttempt=now+BACKOFF_MS;this.status=reason+' · waiting before a fresh offer';
    }
    poll(context={}) {
      const now=this.clock();this.context=context;
      if(!Number.isFinite(now)||now<0||(this.lastClock!==null&&now<this.lastClock)){this.stop('Page clock changed. Press Start again.');return this.view();}this.lastClock=now;
      if(this.active){
        const reason=!context.allowNetwork?'Network tools disabled':!context.supported?'Game build changed':context.hidden?'Tab hidden':context.focused===false?'Game unfocused':context.manualInput?'Manual driving input':context.busy?'Tuner activity':'';
        if(reason)this.stop(reason+'. Press Start again.');
      }
      const valid=this.observe(now);
      if(!this.active){this.changed();return this.view();}
      if(!valid){
        if(this.observationBusy){this.status='Native snapshot busy · waiting for a coherent observation';this.changed();return this.view();}
        this.stop('Native observations lost or stale. Press Start again.');return this.view();
      }
      const s=this.sample;
      // An arm ACK is not a join ACK. Do not enqueue until native has installed
      // our epoch, and never revive after a native watchdog reset.
      if(this.epoch===null){
        if(s.ackSeq===this.armSeq&&s.result===2&&s.nativeActive===true&&s.epoch!==0)this.epoch=s.epoch;
        else if(now-this.armedAt>ARM_MS)this.stop('Native arm was not confirmed. Press Start again.');
        this.changed();return this.view();
      }
      if(s.epoch!==this.epoch||s.nativeActive!==true){this.stop('Native session expired or changed. Press Start again.');return this.view();}
      if(s.state===0&&this.catalogMode&&[...this.selected].some(key=>!this.selectionCurrent(key))){this.stop('A selected destination disappeared or its native context or eligibility changed. Review and reselect before Start.');return this.view();}
      if((context.raceActive||context.raceResults)&&!this.ownsRace()){this.stop('A race outside this hosted queue was entered. Take manual control; press Start again afterward.');return this.view();}
      if(s.state===5&&context.raceActive){
        if(context.driverActive===true){this.driverMissingAt=null;this.driverFailureAt=null;}
        else {
          if(this.driverMissingAt===null)this.driverMissingAt=now;
          if(['failed','retry'].includes(context.driverStatus)){if(this.driverFailureAt===null)this.driverFailureAt=now;}else this.driverFailureAt=null;
          if(now-this.driverMissingAt>10000||(this.driverFailureAt!==null&&now-this.driverFailureAt>3000)){this.stop('Race AI did not confirm. Take manual control; no quit or leave was sent. Press Start again after the race.');return this.view();}
        }
      } else {this.driverMissingAt=null;this.driverFailureAt=null;}
      if(context.menu&&s.state!==5){this.stop('Manual game menu opened. Press Start again.');return this.view();}
      // Pending arm/join writes may not be consumed until the next native pump.
      // Do not replace that command with a heartbeat or treat it as rejection.
      if(s.ackSeq>=s.requestSeq){let heartbeat=false;try{heartbeat=this.client.tick();}catch{}if(heartbeat===false&&this.client.armed===false){this.stop('Native session lost. Press Start again.');return this.view();}}
      if(s.state===1){this.stop('A manually hosted lobby is open. Session stopped.');return this.view();}
      if(this.pending&&[2,3,4,5].includes(s.state)&&(s.currentHost!==this.pending.host||s.currentLobby!==this.pending.lobby)){this.stop('Native lobby identity changed. Press Start again.');return this.view();}
      if(s.state===2){if(!this.pending){this.stop('A different join is pending. Press Start again.');return this.view();}this.pending.asked=true;this.status='Join requested · waiting for host acceptance';}
      else if(s.state===3||s.state===4){
        if(!this.pending&&!this.visited){this.stop('Lobby entered outside this queue. Press Start again.');return this.view();}
        this.visited=true;this.status=s.state===3?'Joined · waiting for the host to start':'Joined · host countdown';
      } else if(s.state===5){
        if(!this.pending&&!this.visited){this.stop('Game trip began outside this queue. Press Start again.');return this.view();}
        this.visited=true;this.status=context.raceActive?(context.driverActive?'Race active · native AI confirmed':'Race active · waiting for race-only AI confirmation'):context.raceResults?'Race countdown / results / return · game controls the transition':'Trip / loading / return · game controls the transition';
      } else if(s.state===0){
        if(this.visited){
          this.lastEvent=this.pending?.eventKey||this.lastEvent;
          // Native can accept a late advert for 30 seconds after the original
          // JOIN, even after a quick cancellation. Do not overlap that window.
          this.nextAttempt=Math.max(now+BACKOFF_MS,(this.pending?.at??now)+LATE_JOIN_MS);
          this.pending=null;this.visited=false;this.attempts.clear();this.status='Returned to free roam · waiting before the next selected host';
        }
        else if(this.pending){
          const p=this.pending;
          if(s.ackSeq===p.seq&&s.result<=0){this.failPending(now,'Native join rejected before sending');}
          else if(p.asked){this.stop('Host acceptance is uncertain; a late acceptance may still arrive. Check the game, then Start again.');return this.view();}
          else if(now-p.at>JOIN_MS){
            // An uncertain send is never blindly retried. Stop clears only our
            // command/AI, not any native lobby membership already obtained.
            this.stop('Join outcome not confirmed. Check the game, then Start again.');return this.view();
          } else this.status=s.ackSeq===p.seq&&s.result===1?'Request sent · acceptance not confirmed':'Join command pending · waiting for native acknowledgement';
        }
        if(!this.pending){
          if(s.inRoam!==true||s.uiEligible!==true||s.worldRuns!==true)this.status='Waiting for eligible free roam at your current position';
          else if(now>=this.nextAttempt){
            const offers=s.offers.filter(o=>{const key=tuple(o),a=this.attempts.get(key);return key&&this.selectedOffer(o)&&(!a||(a.count<3&&a.sequence!==s.sequence&&now>=a.next));});
            const offer=offers.find(o=>descriptor(o).key!==this.lastEvent)||offers[0];
            if(offer){
              const key=tuple(offer),d=descriptor(offer),prior=this.attempts.get(key),count=(prior?.count||0)+1;
              if(this.attempts.size>=128&&!prior){this.stop('Too many changing offers. Review the game, then Start again.');return this.view();}
              const destination=this.selectedOffer(offer);let expectedContext=null;
              if(this.catalogMode){
                let values;try{values=JSON.parse(this.selectionContexts.get(destination?.key));}catch{}
                if(!Array.isArray(values)||values.length!==5){this.stop('Selected destination context is unavailable. Review and reselect before Start.');return this.view();}
                expectedContext={stage:values[0],carId:values[1],raceTableId:values[2],triggerFirst:values[3],triggerEnd:values[4]};
              }
              // v3 serializes a fresh native row only after matching this exact
              // intent/context, then revalidates it again at native dispatch.
              let seq=false;try{seq=this.client.join(offer,destination,expectedContext);}catch{this.stop('Join command outcome is uncertain. Check the game, then Start again.');return this.view();}
              this.nextAttempt=now+BACKOFF_MS;
              // A locally refused stale proof has sent nothing; it must not
              // consume the bounded native-command retry budget.
              this.attempts.set(key,{count:nonzero(seq)?count:(prior?.count||0),sequence:s.sequence,next:now+BACKOFF_MS*Math.pow(2,nonzero(seq)?count-1:0)});
              if(nonzero(seq)){this.pending={seq,host:offer.host,lobby:offer.lobby,eventKey:d.key,selectionKey:this.selectedOffer(offer)?.key,destinationKey:this.selectedOffer(offer)?.destinationKey||null,at:now,asked:false};this.status='Join command pending · waiting for native acknowledgement';}
              else if(this.client.armed===false){this.stop('Native session lost. Press Start again.');return this.view();}
              else this.status='Offer changed or command busy · waiting for a fresh native offer';
            }else {
              const matching=s.offers.filter(o=>this.selectedOffer(o));
              this.status=matching.length&&matching.every(o=>(this.attempts.get(tuple(o))?.count||0)>=3)?'Retry limit reached for current hosts · waiting for a new lobby, or Stop then Start':this.catalogMode?'Waiting here for selected destinations · fresh eligible nearby host required':'Waiting here for selected events · any eligible nearby host';
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if(this.pending&&!this.visited&&now-this.pending.at>JOIN_MS){this.stop('Host acceptance timed out. Check the game, then Start again.');return this.view();}
      this.changed();return this.view();
    }
    ownsRace() {const s=this.sample,p=this.pending;return !!(this.active&&!this.observationBusy&&p&&this.fresh()&&s.state===5&&s.currentHost===p.host&&s.currentLobby===p.lobby);}
    view() {
      const now=this.clock(),fresh=this.fresh(now)&&!this.observationBusy,s=fresh?this.sample:null;
      const duplicates=new Map();for(const r of this.rows.values())if(r.source==='catalog'){if(!duplicates.has(r.eventKey))duplicates.set(r.eventKey,[]);duplicates.get(r.eventKey).push(r.triggerId);}for(const ids of duplicates.values())ids.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      return {active:this.active,status:this.status,pending:!!this.pending,selected:this.selected.size,catalogMode:this.catalogMode,catalogValid:!!s&&this.catalogValid,
        native:s?(this.catalogMode?this.catalogStatus+' · ':'')+nativeLabels[s.state]+' · '+s.offers.length+' eligible nearby offer(s)':'No fresh verified native snapshot',
        rows:[...this.rows.values()].map(r=>{
          const selected=this.selected.has(r.key),catalog=r.source==='catalog',listed=!!s&&this.catalogCurrent.has(r.key),changed=catalog&&selected&&listed&&!this.selectionCurrent(r.key);
          const current=!!s&&(!this.catalogMode||catalog)&&(!catalog||listed)&&descriptor(s.spot)?.key===r.offerKey&&(!catalog||(s.spot.triggerId===r.triggerId&&s.spot.markerHash===r.markerHash&&s.spot.kind===r.kind));
          const ids=duplicates.get(r.eventKey)||[];
          const available=!!s&&(!this.catalogMode||catalog)&&(!catalog||listed)&&!changed&&s.offers.some(o=>descriptor(o)?.key===r.offerKey)&&(!catalog||current);
          return {...r,selected,current,available,listed,changed,selectable:(!this.catalogMode&&!catalog)||(catalog&&listed&&!changed),identity:catalog?`${r.nativeName||'Event'} · ${r.hash}${ids.length>1?' · destination '+(ids.indexOf(r.triggerId)+1)+' of '+ids.length:''} · GPS ${r.route.x}, ${r.route.y}, ${r.route.z}${r.suvRequired?' · SUV required':''}`:r.hash+' · any eligible host'};
        })};

    }
  }
  function mount(doc,container,queue) {
    const make=(tag,text)=>{const node=doc.createElement(tag);if(text)node.textContent=text;return node;};
    const rows=new Map();let empty=null;
    const render=()=>{
      const v=queue.view();container.querySelector('#hosted-state').textContent=v.status;container.querySelector('#hosted-native-state').textContent=v.native;
      container.querySelector('#hosted-start').disabled=v.active||v.selected===0;container.querySelector('#hosted-stop').disabled=!v.active;container.querySelector('#hosted-clear').disabled=v.active;

          bootSession={module:m.mod,memory:m.memory,generation:activeModule===m.mod&&engine?.memory===m.memory?sessionGeneration:-1};
        }
        return Reflect.apply(send, this, [m, ...rest]);
      };
      const currentSession = () => !!bootSession && bootSession.generation===sessionGeneration && bootSession.module===activeModule && bootSession.memory===engine?.memory;
      worker.addEventListener('error', event => {recordDiagnostic('worker-error',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),error:event.error || event.message,tools:diagnosticTools()});if(worker===activeWorker&&currentSession())stopHostedSession('Game worker error. Press Start again.');});
      worker.addEventListener('message', event => {
        const m = event.data;
        if(m?.t==='trap')recordDiagnostic('game-trap',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),tid:m.tid,error:m.msg,stack:m.stack,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(m?.t==='exit')recordDiagnostic('game-exit',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),code:m.code,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(!currentSession())return;
        if(worker===activeWorker && m?.t==='register' && m.kind===HostedNative?.constants.registrationKind && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr))hostedNative?.register(m.ptr,m.size??HostedNative.constants.SIZE);
        if(m?.t==='register' && (m.kind===3||m.kind===5))recordDiagnostic('game-register',{kind:m.kind});
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 3 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) inputPtr = m.ptr;
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 5 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) statusPtr = m.ptr;
        if (m?.t === 'exit' || m?.t === 'trap') {detachHostedSession('Game stopped. Press Start again.');suspend('Game stopped. Enabled choices are kept for the next game.');ai=null;wall=null;cars=null;dyno=null;engine=null;activeWorker=null;activeModule=null;moduleProfile=null;refreshCompatibility();statusPtr=0;inputPtr=0;}
      });
      return worker;
    }
  });
  // A different game revision must be reviewed before writing its memory.
  fetch('/game.json', { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' }).then(r => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Build information unavailable');
    return r.json();
  }).then(info => {
    revision = String(info.rev || 'unknown');refreshCompatibility();
    recordDiagnostic('build',{revision,supported});
    if (!supported) message('Waiting for an exact verified game module. Unknown builds stay disabled.');
  }).catch(error => {recordDiagnostic('build-error',{error});message('Could not check game version. Memory tools stay disabled.');});

  function key(code, down) {
    const keyName = { ArrowUp: 'ArrowUp', ShiftLeft: 'Shift', AltLeft: 'Alt' }[code] || code;
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(down ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code, key: keyName,
      location: /Left$/.test(code) ? 1 : 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  }
  function hold(code, down) {
    if (down && !held.has(code)) { if (!physicallyHeld.has(code)) { held.add(code); key(code, true); } }
    else if (!down && held.delete(code) && !physicallyHeld.has(code)) key(code, false);
  }
  function release() { clearTimeout(shiftTimer); for (const code of [...held]) hold(code, false); }
  function suspend(why) {
    stopHostedSession('Hosted session stopped. Press Start again.');
    dyno?.cancel();
    wall?.stop();cars?.stop(); ai?.stop(); release(); powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
    try {if(engine){const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}} catch { /* no stale pointer writes */ }
    clearApplicationEvidence();
    if(why) message(why);
  }
  function stop(why = 'Driving controls off. F9 cleared driving assists and network permission. Saved profiles are kept. Load one manually, or select it and enable Load on startup to resume.', persistProfilePause=true) {
    profileStartup=null;loadedProfile=null;profileActionEpoch++;profileActionPending=false;if(profileDriftChoice)driftNeedsReapply=false;profileDriftChoice=false;
    // Keep an already-issued drift request pending until confirmation/timeout: a
    // native toggle cannot be recalled safely, and a second must not overlap it.
    if(persistProfilePause){
      profileSessionStopped=true;
      try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
      const result=profileStore?.pause();
      profileNotice=result?.error||'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.';
      renderProfiles();
    }
    recordDiagnostic('stop',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
    clearRaceOnlyAI();
    dynoEnabled=false;dyno?.setEnabled(false);if(ui)ui.querySelector('#dyno-enable').checked=false;
    adaptiveRaceEnabled=false;if(ui)ui.querySelector('#adaptive-race').checked=false;
    prefs.raceCornerAssist=false;prefs.cornerAssist=false;prefs.racePace=false;prefs.walls=false;prefs.cars=false;prefs.traffic=false;prefs.players=false;prefs.online=false;prefs.ai=false;prefs.aiPace=false;prefs.nos=false;prefs.dragNoBlowout=false;prefs.drag=false;prefs.boost=false;prefs.unlimit=false;prefs.grip=false;savePrefs();suspend();
    if(ui) for(const id of ['race-corner-assist','corner-assist','race-pace','walls','cars','traffic','players','online','ai','ai-pace','nos','drag-no-blowout','drag','boost','unlimit','grip']) ui.querySelector('#'+id).checked=false;
    message(profileNotice&&persistProfilePause ? why+' '+profileNotice : why);
  }

  }

  function raceOnlyRaceContext() {

    if(!supported||!engine||!statusPtr)return false;

  }
  function takeControl() {

  }
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!e.isTrusted) return;
    if(e.code==='Insert' && e.shiftKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey && !e.metaKey){
      // Shift+Insert remains Paste in text/editable controls, including controls
      // inside a shadow root. Otherwise it mirrors the existing F8 menu action.
      const path=e.composedPath?.()||[e.target];
      const editingNode=node=>{
        for(let depth=0;node&&depth<32;depth++,node=node.parentElement){
          if(node.isContentEditable || node.getAttribute?.('role')==='textbox' || /^(TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(node.tagName) || (node.tagName==='INPUT' && !/^(button|checkbox|radio|range|submit|reset|color|file|image|hidden)$/.test(String(node.type||'').toLowerCase())))return true;
        }
        return false;
      };
      // Window's composedPath hides our closed shadow tree. Its retained
      // activeElement is required to preserve Paste in the profile-name field.
      const editing=[...path,ui?.activeElement,document.activeElement].some(editingNode);
      if(e.isComposing || e.defaultPrevented || editing)return;
      e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setPanel(!visible);return;
    }
    // Range controls keep their native arrow/Space behavior without taking over the car.
    if(host && e.composedPath?.().includes(host) && !['F6','F7','F8','F9','Escape'].includes(e.code)) return;
    if(e.code==='F6'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setInfoHud(!infoHudEnabled);return;}
    physicallyHeld.add(e.code);
    if(hostedSession?.active&&!(host&&e.composedPath?.().includes(host))&&['Enter','Escape','KeyE'].includes(e.code))stopHostedSession('Manual game action. Press Start again.');
    if(e.code==='F7') {e.preventDefault();takeControl();}
    else if((hostedSession?.active || prefs.ai || (raceOnlyAI && raceOnlyRaceContext())) && ['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','Space'].includes(e.code)) takeControl();
    if (e.code === 'F8') { e.preventDefault(); setPanel(!visible); }
    if (e.code === 'Escape' && visible) setPanel(false);

  }, true);

  function setDrift(wanted) {
    if (driftPending) return false;
    const state = engine?.state(), counters = engine && statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
    if (!supported || !state?.ready || !state.driving || state.network || !counters || (counters.drive & 3) !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(counters.drift) || document.hidden || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
      message('Drift assist only works while driving solo free roam with the game menus closed.'); return false;
    }
    if (!!(counters.drift & 1) === wanted) return true;
    // Rebuilding the native drift setup must not inherit our power multiplier.
    engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);powerGate.reset();gripGate.reset();
    if (!engine.driftTap(inputPtr)) { message('Drift request not sent: the game input mailbox is unavailable, inactive, typing, or full.'); return false; }
    driftPending = { wanted, until: performance.now() + 3000 };
    ui.querySelector('#drift').disabled = true;
    message('Drift request sent. Waiting for the game to confirm its handling state…');
    return true;
  }
  function moduleFailure() {
    const patch=AI?.patchState;
    if(moduleProfile || patch?.phase!=='unavailable')return '';
    const reported=/^[a-f0-9]{8,40}$/.test(revision)?` Site reports build ${revision}.`:'';
    const bytes=Number.isSafeInteger(patch.moduleBytes)?` Loaded module: ${patch.moduleBytes} bytes.`:'';
    const signatures=Number.isInteger(patch.signatureUnique)?` Fingerprints: ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal} unique matches; this does not approve an unknown build.`:'';
    return ['module-size','module-hash'].includes(patch.patchCode)
      ? `Game module is not verified.${reported}${bytes} A compatible Driving Tools update is required.${signatures}`
      : `Game module could not be prepared.${reported} Reload once. If it persists, export the diagnostic log.`;
  }

      if (activeDrag) {

        if (s.driving && prefs.nos && nos && s.gear >= 3) hold('AltLeft', true); else hold('AltLeft', false);

        }

'Online/LAN opt-in' : 'Game linked'} · ${Math.round(s.rpm)} RPM${prefs.nos ? nos ? ' · NOS refilling' : ' · NOS unavailable/paused' : ''}${tune.active ? ` · Power ${tune.power.toFixed(1)}×${tune.unlimit ? ' · Governor off' : ''}` : (prefs.boost || prefs.unlimit) ? ' · Power controls waiting/unavailable' : ''}${grip.active ? ` · Grip ${grip.factor.toFixed(1)}×` : prefs.grip ? ' · Grip paused/unavailable' : ''}${prefs.drag ? activeDrag ? dragCountdown ? ' · Drag countdown throttle' : ' · Drag throttle/shifting · you steer' : dragTakenOver ? ' · Drag paused for manual control' : dragRace && !manualDriver ? ' · Drag waiting for native handback' : ' · Drag assist paused/waiting' : ''}`;
      if (ui) {
        const caps=moduleProfile?.capabilities;
        for(const [id,feature] of [['ai-pace','pace'],['pace-factor','pace'],['race-pace','pace'],['race-pace-factor','pace'],['race-corner-assist','corner'],['race-corner-factor','corner'],['race-corner-margin','corner'],['race-braking','corner'],['corner-assist','corner'],['corner-factor','corner'],['corner-margin','corner'],['walls','walls'],['cars','cars'],['traffic','onlineTraffic'],['players','onlinePlayers'],['dyno-enable','dyno']]){const control=ui.querySelector('#'+id);if(control)control.disabled=(feature==='onlineTraffic'||feature==='onlinePlayers')?caps?.[feature]!==true:!!caps&&!caps[feature];}

  function setPanel(open) {
